open_finding_start_vs_ps3_ocp.effect: only a fan drawing >= about 4.96 A at 12.4 V trips PS3 (fan rated max 2.70 A); then the controller resets (fails safe). Fan start / lock current is a bench item (DECISIONS C49)

source: SS14 class Schottky datasheet VF max

overload.note: PS3 trips only if the 12 V load draws more than fan_current_to_trip_lowest_ocp_A; the buck can pass its own limit (4.2-5.8 A peak), so a short is bounded by hiccup, and only a fan drawing >= this current can trip PS3 at start.

ps3_loss.gate_drive: the drivers' VDDI UVLO forces the outputs low within the times above after the buck stops, before the MCU (brown-out about 2.43 V) can drive anything; the PERMIT path (supervisor filter, U37) is independent and not timed here
